stem: Two rooted clones are the same age, but one has a stronger root system and more vigorous growth. What is the strongest stage-transition decision?
choices: Advance each plant according to establishment and readiness rather than age alone
Advance both because their calendar age matches
Hold both until every plant is identical
Advance the weaker clone first to catch up
rationale: Calendar age is a planning cue; biological establishment and readiness should govern stage transitions.
